title: Baked Fish Tagine
description: A traditional algerian dish with a nostalgic twist, featuring flaky baked fish in a flavorful tagine sauce.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Season the fish fillets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the preserved lemon and cook for 2-3 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Transfer the fish fillets to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until browned on both sides.
Transfer the fish to the prepared baking sheet and bake for 8-10 minutes, until cooked through.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve with nostalgic olives on top.
